ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels representing a low macro-level white-to-black ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel blobs localized at the lateral tips of both lobes; scattered high-intensity point-like pixels across the lower regions of the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical recess relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of sawtooth-like peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in amplitude along the horizontal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending laterally from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast circular clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct, diagonal linear pixel disruption of lighter intensity (grey) crossing the dark substrate on the interior of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on the distal tips and a prominent linear rake mark/scratch on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity water droplet noise and spray obscuring the lower ventral-medial pixel data.
